test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

“I wish I had something to eat. I am so hungry.” said Chippa.

options.text: Chippa said he wishes he has something to eat as he is so hungry.
Chippa said I wish I have something to eat as I am so hungry.
Chippa said he wishes he had something to eat as he was so hungry.
Chippa said he wished he had something to eat as he was so hungry.

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is __'**Chippa said he wished he had something to eat as he was so hungry.'**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 
 
said Chippa. 

 
 
 
I wish I had something to eat. I am so hungry

 
 
 

__Reporting clause__ __Reported speech__

__
 
• When the reporting speech is in Simple present tense then all the speech Changes to Simple past tense.

 
 
• am----- was, wish-----wished
 
 
 
• Said of the reporting verb remains the same.
 
• **I(first person)** of the Reported Speech changed according to the subject of the Reporting clause(**He**).
 
• Connect the clauses of reported speech with a conjunction(**as**).

​So, the final sentence is: ​Chippa said he wished he had something to eat as he was so hungry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__What is Direct & Indirect Speech?__

 
• 
 Direct speech – reporting the message of the speaker in the exact words as spoken by him.

 
 
• Direct speech example: Maya said, "I am busy now".
 
 
 
• 
 Indirect speech: reporting the message of the speaker in our own words 

 
 
• Indirect speech example: Maya said that she was busy then.
